changes.comment: sdk-ui-analytical-designer: Open and save visualizations whose date filter references a period (a DATE_RANGE parameter), on the filter bar and on metrics. The filter chip shows the period's title, or its id when the catalog does not have the period.

sdk-backend-tiger: The available catalog items of an insight no longer depend on the period (date range parameter) its date filters reference, only on their date data set, so an insight whose period was deleted still gets them.
